title: Without Customers Create & Edit the Delete Customer window has no Remove button
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as a user whose role has 'Customers → Delete' and 'View and Manage AP/AR Data' but not 'Customers → Create & Edit', at the test location.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, the payer, with no work orders, part sales, assets or contacts of its own.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, whose Bill Invoices To is saved as customer B.
custom_steps:
1. Open customer B's Edit Customer window.
  2. Click Delete.
  3. Click Delete in the Confirmation window.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Customer B's Edit Customer window opens.

Step 2:

  • A "Confirmation" window asks "Are you sure you want to delete this company?" with "Cancel" and "Delete".

Step 3:

  • A "Delete Customer" window opens: "This customer is the default Bill To for [customer A's name]. Remove it from that customer first."
  • The window has "Cancel".
  • No "Remove As Default Bill To" button shows.

Words in square brackets in a message stand for the value they name, such as customer B's name exactly as it is saved; every other word of the message must match exactly.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12303 (Story 1, Saved default Bill To on the customer page), story SV-12314 (Story 12, Deleting a customer that pays for others)

  • S12-N1: “Without 'Customers → Create & Edit' and 'View and Manage AP/AR Data', "Remove As Default Bill To" is hidden.”
  • Key Decisions: “Setting or removing a saved default Bill To needs 'Customers → Create & Edit' and 'View and Manage AP/AR Data' (the Credit Terms pattern).”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
